meta.label: Story: audit aggregate
meta.description: Stream the host audit logs ($DIP_HOME/run/audit/audit.log*) and aggregate human UI activity into per-UTC-day rows (viewing vs developing per user/project, plus raw msgType counts). Pure parse — no database access; the hub's 'Story: collect analytics' macro calls this on each host and persists the result.

params.name: since_day
params.label: Cursor day (YYYY-MM-DD, exclusive)
params.description: Days at or before this date are skipped — they are already final in the Story database.

params.name: max_files
params.label: Max rotated files to read (0 = all)
